outputs: Generated answers for question answering tasks

changes_made.explanation: Removed tasks that were only mentioned as examples of LLM applications but not actually evaluated in the paper. Kept only models that were explicitly used for NLG tasks (question answering). Consolidated duplicate outputs and normalized model names.
Normalized metric names to base forms and removed redundant entries. The paper evaluates generation tasks using standard metrics for question answering.
The paper does not use LLMs as judges/evaluators of generated outputs. All evaluation is done through automatic metrics.
The paper does not conduct human evaluations of generated outputs. All evaluations are automated.

overall_notes: This paper primarily focuses on parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods (LoRETTA) for large language models. While the paper mentions various NLG applications, the actual NLG evaluation is limited to question answering tasks (SQuAD, DROP) using standard automatic metrics. The main contribution is the PEFT method itself rather than extensive NLG evaluation.
